reference_rule: For selected synapses replace only force-dependent presynaptic rate deviations by the matched no-force trajectory: drive += sum(w * anatomical_fraction * (r_reference - r_current)). No weight renormalization; neck retained.
region_rule: Synapse location, not neuron soma. DN/AN have a single shared model state; no compartment model.
primary: Paired change in failure-adjusted heading AUC, averaged over signs, states, and amplitudes 10,15,20 within checkpoint.
mechanistic: Separate unconditional flip risk, survival without heading recovery, and joint success; report brain by VNC interaction and readout by intervention differences.
heading_detail: Heading error in pairs where both branches survive is descriptive and selected after treatment; report the number retained and transitions across all pairs.
temporal: 0..500 ms curves; absorbing flip risk; heading error missing after termination shown with explicit pi penalty. Do not mistake penalized error for measured heading.
statistics: Exploratory. Individual checkpoint paired effects and checkpoint bootstrap 95% intervals (20000 draws); no episode-level significance tests, no additive causal percentages, no equivalence claim for small effects.
pairing: Same complete physics/CPG/hidden/RNG snapshot within a checkpoint, force sign and magnitude; different models have separately reached states, not identical cross-model posture.
pilot: Two seed0 readouts, eval700 phase0, all six interventions at 0 and +/-15; engineering subset only, not used to choose arms or force grid.
reuse: All branches and reference states are newly simulated within this run.
